g.title: ESXi host networking
g.text: ESXi hosts (ESX-W01 and VDI-E01, 7 hosts): vSwitch and dvSwitch, teaming, LACP and MTU are not drawn.
Collected: vmnic0 to vmnic3 per host (2 x 10 GbE, 2 x 25 GbE link speed) and 6 port groups.
Source of truth for this network: vCenter 198.51.100.31 and 198.51.100.32.
